_comment: Hand-labelled ground truth for sample_auth.log. Each entry is one (rule, source_ip) pair a correct run must produce. Anything the tool reports that is not listed here counts as a false positive.

expected.note: 12 failed root logins in 88s. Paired pam_unix and preauth lines must not be double counted.
7 distinct non-existent usernames in 150s. Only 7 failures, so brute_force must stay silent for this IP.
6 failures over 200s then a success. Too slow for brute_force at a 120s window, so only this rule should fire.

known_benign.note: Real user mistypes a password 3 times then succeeds. Any alert on this IP is a false positive.
